key_insight: Simulation-driven optimization improved hydrofoil efficiency, with adjoint optimization delivering a reported 15% increase over the conventional design.
engineering_relevance: CFD-based design optimization can replace intuition-led hydrofoil tuning with systematic exploration of higher-performing geometries.
method: Digitize a conventional hydrofoil using structured-light scanning and explore five aircraft-wing-inspired designs.
Use design-of-experiments CFD data to train a machine-learning surrogate for multi-objective optimization.
Apply adjoint optimization to refine geometries beyond the surrogate’s restricted design parameters.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports promising surrogate-based results and a 15% efficiency increase from adjoint optimization, with gains tied to specific operating conditions.
watch_item: Benefits require validation across operating conditions; surrogate parameter limits and realistic geometric constraints affect design exploration.
paper_title: Improving Hydrofoil Efficiency Through Simulation-Driven Design Optimization
